def solve_dp(horizon,c,mus,variances,lam,transition):
    P=[-1,0,1]; Q=[-1,0,1]
    V=np.zeros((horizon+1,3,2)); A=np.zeros((horizon+1,3,2))
    for pi,p in enumerate(P):
        for z in range(2):
            V[0,pi,z]=-c*abs(p); A[0,pi,z]=0
    for n in range(1,horizon+1):
        for pi,p in enumerate(P):
            for z in range(2):
                cands=[]
                for qi,q in enumerate(Q):
                    cont=sum(transition[z][z2]*V[n-1,qi,z2] for z2 in range(2))
                    val=q*mus[z]-lam*q*q*variances[z]/2-c*abs(q-p)+cont
                    cands.append((val,qi,q))
                best=max(v for v,_,_ in cands)
                tied=[t for t in cands if best-t[0]<=1e-10]
                tied.sort(key=lambda t:(abs(t[2]-p),abs(t[2]),t[2]))
                V[n,pi,z]=tied[0][0]; A[n,pi,z]=tied[0][2]
    return {'values':V.tolist(),'actions':A.tolist()}

    P=[-1,0,1]
    best=None

        if n==0: return -c*abs(p),{}
        out=[]
        for q in [-1,0,1]:
